observed_vs_inferred.observed: Primary card documents visitor/item actions, transactions, timestamped weekly property snapshots and category/availability semantics. Static local DSL declares explicit five-field typed schema, all three actions, reviewed templates/windows and B41/manual18 closure.
observed_vs_inferred.inferred: 13-digit Unix examples suggest milliseconds; future adapter must validate unit/range without silently choosing seconds. Same visitor key can define daily observed-visitor targets; durable account/person/cross-device identity is not established.

four_fields.mechanism: Capability-declared event-only adapter for user/item/pair count, distinct and recency operators; unsupported metadata branches remain unsupported.
four_fields.prediction: Original visitor-key 48h eligibility and daily fullY 24h purchase items survive the adapter; session-actor replacement and future metadata joins must be refused.

adapter_caveats: Current feature_programs.py is exact-schema/reviewed-template code, not already portable runtime. Projection of manual18/B41/category branches requires explicit prospective review; no silent adapter accepted here.

If metadata is ever enabled, distinguish event-enriched frozen attributes from query-current snapshots; source REES46 fields are event observed. Do not backfill future property values or claim actual release availability from snapshot timestamps.

Event-time availability assumptions and whole-window mature labels must be explicit. Full past 7-day retrieval coverage, 48h cohort and full 24h label coverage are separately checked; source overlap is not exposure/account age.
matched_control: Explicit hand-written common event-only registry, same typed meanings, Q/C, history, peer exclusion, NULL policy, 24/168h windows and observed actor keys. For future quality work, equal complete search/control fit and feedback budgets must be separately specified; present proposal does not choose new model settings.

counterexamples.literal: Anchor t is daily UTC midnight; visitor 7 views at t-40 minutes and transacts item X at t+10 minutes.
counterexamples.expected: Visitor-key actor is eligible from past48h and X is a target in [t,t+24h). A 30-minute sessionizer places purchase in a new future-only actor and loses the original target.

counterexamples.literal: Property category A at t-1h; category B at t+1h for the same item.
counterexamples.expected: A full-file latest join exposes B at t; a strict-past snapshot join cannot. Snapshot timestamps alone still do not prove publication times.

negative_disposition: Reject unsupported equivalence or fail the adapter; do not switch to next-session target, shrink/reshape cohort or C to claim success. Valid schema audit without measured quality remains only semantic evidence.
